content_data.meeting_title: Research Collaboration Kick-off: Next-Gen Network Slicing for 6G
agenda_items: Establishing communication protocols and regular check-in cadence
Defining initial research objectives and scope for the collaboration
Review of current literature on dynamic network slicing optimization
Allocation of preliminary tasks and roles for the first phase
key_decisions: Formulate joint publication strategy for relevant academic conferences within the next 12 months.
Prioritize AI-driven predictive resource allocation for network slice management.
attendees: Professor Jian Li, Head of Research, Telecommunications Innovations
Dr. Kenji Tanaka, Senior Research Scientist, AI & Machine Learning Division
